nodes.notes: TODO: set the real Gmail OAuth2 credential. Polling every minute to start -- widen the interval once this is stable to reduce API usage. n8n's Gmail Trigger dedupes on message ID between polls by default, so re-processing the same message on every poll shouldn't happen, but worth confirming in testing.

parameters.query:
-- 0035: the agency whose connected Gmail address is ANY of the recipients
-- (To, Cc, Bcc), ignoring case -- not only the first "To". Always outputs, so
-- an email for an unknown mailbox reaches 'Log Unmatched Mailbox'.
select ac.tenant_id, ac.connected_gmail_address, t.slug as tenant_slug, t.name as tenant_name
from ai_config ac
join tenants t on t.id = ac.tenant_id and t.status = 'active'
where lower(btrim(ac.connected_gmail_address)) = any($1::text[])
limit 1;

nodes.name: Upsert Contact
nodes.notes: Upserts on the tenant_id+email unique constraint from Phase 5. Deliberately no lead scoring/escalation here -- this just makes sure an email from a new sender gets a contact row, same as chat does via capture_lead, so email leads don't fall outside the pipeline. TODO: confirm 'contacts' table has no other NOT NULL columns beyond tenant_id/email that would make a bare insert fail (e.g. a required 'source' or 'name' column) -- add them to the insert if so.

parameters.query:
-- Replaces the current query in "Get or Create Conversation (Email)".
-- Old version only returned a row on first creation -- returned nothing if
-- the conversation already existed, which is fine when nothing downstream
-- needs the ID, but message-logging needs a reliable ID every time.
with existing as (
  select id from conversations
  where tenant_id = $1 and contact_id = $2 and channel = 'email'
  limit 1
),
inserted as (
  insert into conversations (tenant_id, contact_id, channel)
  select $1, $2, 'email'
  where not exists (select 1 from existing)
  returning id
)
select id from existing
union all
select id from inserted;

nodes.name: Get or Create Conversation (Email)
nodes.notes: TODO: this INSERT...WHERE NOT EXISTS returns nothing on the 'already exists' path (a Postgres quirk) -- you'll need a follow-up SELECT (or a CTE combining both) to reliably get the conversation_id either way. Also confirm 'conversations' table actually has a 'channel' column -- if it doesn't, this needs a small migration too, and email threads should probably map many gmail_thread_ids to one ongoing conversation per contact rather than one-per-thread; adjust the matching logic if so.

parameters.query:
-- An email reached Gmail but no agency has any of its recipients as its
-- connected address (Settings -> Gmail address). Logged, not silently dropped.
insert into audit_log (tenant_id, actor_type, actor_id, event_type, details)
values (null, 'system', 'workflow_16', 'email_unmatched_mailbox', $1::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify({ recipients: $('Extract Email Fields').first().json.recipients, from: $('Extract Email Fields').first().json.from_email, subject: $('Extract Email Fields').first().json.subject }) ] }}

parameters.query:
-- Each email is answered once, even if Gmail hands it over again (0032/0035).
-- 0039: keyed by the email's own Message-ID, like workflow 40, so an email that
-- also arrives through the forwarding address isn't answered twice.
select claim_whatsapp_message($1, case when $2 <> '' then 'email:' || lower(btrim($2)) else 'gmail:' || $3 end) as is_new;

parameters.query:
-- 0046: where Storage is (Supabase project URL), for the attachments.
select supabase_url from platform_settings limit 1;

-- 0046: the file, for the conversation page (uploaded = Storage accepted it).
insert into message_attachments (tenant_id, conversation_id, email_message_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, storage_path, uploaded, read_by_elliot)
values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, nullif($3, ''), $4, $5, $6::bigint, $7, $8::boolean, $9::boolean)
on conflict (storage_path) do update set uploaded = excluded.uploaded
returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const m = $('Attachment Files').item.json; const ok = Number($json.statusCode) >= 200 && Number($json.statusCode) < 300; return [ m.tenant_id, m.conversation_id, m.email_message_id || '', m.filename, m.content_type, m.size || 0, m.path, ok, ok && m.readable ]; })() }}
